scope: Paired mask utility for a second native gene predictor in two D-training species; not external-species generalization

geometry.selection: Autosomes in decreasing assembly length; one core per chromosome. Candidate starts are 1 Mb grid points ranked by distance to chromosome midpoint, ties lower coordinate. Reject halo overlap with D TRAIN or CAL; take first eligible per chromosome. No sequence, annotation or outcome selection.

D.calibration: existing frozen six-species CAL; no refit

R_TE.excluded: simple repeats, low complexity, satellites and RNA; ambiguous class suffix ? retained
R_TE.claim: historical reference mask, not a newly timed RepeatMasker run

RED.scope: all native repeats, trained on the fixed 52 Mb halo panel per species

augustus.training: existing native same-species parameters; no fitting

score.primary: exact complete CDS-chain gene-locus F1, D minus U
score.reference: all complete protein-coding ncbiRefSeq genePredExtended isoforms on the exact assembly
score.ownership: first CDS base inside core, entire CDS chain within halo
score.inference: regional paired sensitivity, not biological replicates; no noninferiority claim

resources.D_mask: 1 RTX3090, 4 CPU, 32 GB, 1 h per species; prior same-checkpoint 100 MiB run used 4.4 GiB RSS and 32 minutes
resources.predict: 1 CPU, 8 GB, 24 h per core, at most 4 cores at once

stopping: Complete both species and all four arms irrespective of effect direction. No outcome-based region replacement, parameter optimization or additional seeds.
